purpose: Teach: カンファレンス/コマーシャル/プロバイダー/申し入れ/立候補/過半数/申立/処遇

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、来月のカンファレンスに登壇しろ
lines.en: I want you presenting at next month's conference.
lines.style: Direct, clipped authority. No preamble. Expectation stated as fact. Steady eye contact, minimal inflection—this is a directive, not a request.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品のコマーシャルを来週放送します
lines.en: Yes. We're airing the new product commercial next week.
lines.style: Brisk confirmation. Rapid-fire delivery, professional cadence. Lean slightly forward—showing readiness, not hesitation. Efficient.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社のプロバイダー契約を見直せ
lines.style: Terse, authoritative. Slight pause after the verb—letting the weight land. No softening, no elaboration. The tone of someone used to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。取引先からの申し入れ、対応中です
lines.en: Yes. We're currently addressing requests from our business partners.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact update. Steady tempo, no rush. Shoulders level—showing control of the situation. Brief, precise, no apology in the phrasing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員の役員立候補を歓迎する
lines.en: I welcome any staff member who wants to run for executive.
lines.style: Measured declaration. Slight warmth beneath the formality—this is genuine support. Deliberate pace, like the words carry weight. A rare moment of openness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。株主総会で過半数の支持を得ました
lines.en: Yes. We secured majority support from shareholders at the general meeting.
lines.style: Confident report. Quick, clean delivery—this is good news being delivered without self-congratulation. Steady gaze, no need for embellishment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、訴訟の申立に備えろ
lines.en: Prepare the company for potential litigation.
lines.style: Grave, deliberate. Each word lands with equal weight. No rush—this is serious. The tone drops slightly, more bass. A chair creaks as he settles back.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の処遇改善を進めております
lines.en: Yes. We're advancing improvements to staff compensation and conditions.
lines.style: Steady, professional close. Measured pace, completing the thought with care. No edge—just competence. A small nod acknowledgment implicit in the tone.
